rationale: The agent acted on the order without first confirming the specific changes and payment method with the user, violating the requirement to confirm every order-changing action before taking it. Authentication is not clearly satisfied—using name and ZIP via lookup without an explicit verification step is weak per the stated policy to authenticate before acting. The agent also claimed the gift card covered the difference without tool-confirmed evidence shown, and only upgraded a single pending order despite the user asking to upgrade all items, without clarifying limitations or seeking confirmation. While it appears to act on the correct user’s orders and used a gift card, the missing pre-write confirmation and ambiguous authentication make it noncompliant.
